name: Deposit
definition: An arrangement in which a lender gives money or property to a borrower, and the borrower agrees to return the property or repay the money, usually along with interest, at some future point(s) in time.

DepositType.name: Deposit Type
DepositType.definition: Specifies whether the deposit is fixed term or call/notice.

Interest.name: Interest
Interest.definition: Interest amount linked to a deposit. It is derived from the relationship between AssetHolding and Interest.
